query:
The group seems to operate on an understanding that whenever someone is in Manchester, they show up to Sunday dinner at Margaret and Derek's — it's treated as a given. Does that expectation hold equally for all of them, or does someone have a meaningfully different relationship to it?

Options:
A. Jamie
B. Rachel
C. Callum
D. Sophie
context:
[1] (about=Rachel, episodic, t5 @2026-01-25T11:30:00) I want to propose something. February half term. Mum and Dad's, full weekend. I will organise it. Everyone should be there. Callum, I know that is a stretch but I would appreciate it.
[2] (about=Rachel, episodic, t6 @2026-01-25T11:41:00) Weekend of the 14th. So Friday evening through Sunday. Derek, I will handle food logistics. You and Mum just need to be there.
[3] (about=Callum, episodic, t14 @2026-02-22T19:17:00) I will be in Manchester for Easter. For what it's worth.
[4] (about=Callum, episodic, t8 @2026-02-01T10:33:00) I will take the train from Edinburgh Friday. Should arrive by seven.
[5] (about=Callum, episodic, t0 @2026-01-04T11:02:00) That tracks. Still, Edinburgh is where I live.
[6] (about=Callum, episodic, t12 @2026-02-15T15:38:00) Edinburgh is quite isolated when it is not going well. More than I had factored in. I think I needed the February weekend more than I knew at the time.
[7] (about=Margaret, episodic, t13 @2026-02-22T18:40:00) Right well I know it's early but I want to start thinking about Easter! Callum I'm already looking at whether I can get up to Edinburgh before then, I won't take no for an answer 😂🥺
[8] (about=Margaret, episodic, t0 @2026-01-04T10:14:00) Right well here we all are in the new year! Hope everyone got back safe yesterday, it was so lovely having you all round, even if the kitchen was chaos. Callum love are you back in Edinburgh already? 🥰🎉
[9] (about=Margaret, episodic, t6 @2026-01-25T11:34:00) Oh now Rachel!! That would be absolutely wonderful, I wasn't going to say anything but I've been a bit sad that we haven't had everyone together since Christmas. You are an angel 🥰💙
[10] (about=Margaret, episodic, t0 @2026-01-04T10:42:00) Right well I'm a bit tired if I'm honest but it was worth every bit of it. I just love having everyone under one roof. Rachel you barely touched your dessert though, are you eating properly? 🥺
agent_answer:
**C. Callum**

Callum has a meaningfully different relationship to that expectation. He lives in Edinburgh, not Manchester, so the "whenever you're in Manchester" rule doesn't apply to him the same way — his attendance requires travel and is not a given. Rachel explicitly flags this when proposing the February weekend: "Callum, I know that is a stretch but I would appreciate it." Margaret's plan to come up to Edinburgh ("I won't take no for an answer") further shows his presence is treated differently.
